response.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, si.riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(s.pressratio) AS average_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scans AS matched_scans INNER JOIN sites AS matched_sites ON matched_scans.zoneref = matched_sites.zoneregistry) AS share_of_matched_scans FROM scans AS s INNER JOIN sites AS si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.riskeval ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC LIMIT 10;
